label: Blind sample 051: Hansen forest loss 2020, tile 50N_130W

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.35 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2020 (90% interval −0.46 to +0.00). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02). The interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out.
reasons: the interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
